**Current**
- Yahoo lists him as questionable for rest. (fact, 2026-10-16; stats)
- Booker is projected to start for Phoenix next to Jalen Green, Dillon Brooks, Miles Bridges and Oso Ighodaro. (fact, 2026-10-14; [10-14](https://youtu.be/MRzebgip23Y?t=508))
- Phoenix may play him off the ball more this season, which could keep his assists down. (verdict, 2026-10-14; [10-14](https://youtu.be/MRzebgip23Y?t=220), [10-14](https://youtu.be/MRzebgip23Y?t=313))
- Jalen Green's usage could squeeze him a little. Miles Bridges and Dillon Brooks also take touches in a crowded Phoenix offense. (verdict, 2026-10-14; [10-14](https://youtu.be/D4dP5JvX1oo?t=652), [10-14](https://youtu.be/D4dP5JvX1oo?t=684), [09-19](https://youtu.be/uarqbNA2dFk?t=387), [09-19](https://youtu.be/uarqbNA2dFk?t=989), [10-09](https://youtu.be/-DN4P92Wp8Y?t=2437))
- He is expected to be the best fantasy player on the Suns by a wide margin. (verdict, 2026-10-14; [10-14](https://youtu.be/MRzebgip23Y?t=220))
- The experts disagree on a bounce back. One says he can bounce back. Others doubt it and expect a season close to last year's finish around 40th in category leagues. (verdict, 2026-10-14; [10-14](https://youtu.be/D4dP5JvX1oo?t=652), [10-14](https://youtu.be/MRzebgip23Y?t=351), [10-06](https://youtu.be/eTsjuVu1trk?t=1961), [10-09](https://youtu.be/-DN4P92Wp8Y?t=742), [09-09](https://youtu.be/7BllEsdNLoM?t=1516))
- If he gets back to about 2.4 threes a game at 35%, he could be roughly a 28th to 30th ranked player. (verdict, 2026-10-14; [10-14](https://youtu.be/MRzebgip23Y?t=313))
- He is a fade at his market price. Do not take him in round two or early round three in category leagues. Take him around picks 35 to 38. Going around pick 27 in mocks is a bit early. (verdict, 2026-10-14; [10-14](https://youtu.be/MRzebgip23Y?t=351), [10-13](https://youtu.be/EogBYa24Gto?t=524), [10-13](https://youtu.be/DzQXaC2rsac?t=643), [09-19](https://youtu.be/uarqbNA2dFk?t=387), [10-06](https://youtu.be/eTsjuVu1trk?t=1961), [10-09](https://youtu.be/-DN4P92Wp8Y?t=413))
- Phoenix has the best fantasy schedule in the league: 4, 4 and 4 games in the playoff weeks, and the fewest back-to-backs. (fact, 2026-10-14; [10-14](https://youtu.be/MRzebgip23Y?t=1786))
- In auctions, Josh values him in the low 20s USD. In a mock he went for 22 USD, which Josh called a good price. (verdict, 2026-10-05; [10-05](https://youtu.be/Q6YlQDvD-aY?t=2307))
- The Suns do not want Booker to be the primary point guard. They want to lower his ballhandling load and make spacing easier for him. (fact, 2026-08-23; [08-23](https://youtu.be/hm5-fiCa5S4?t=900))

**Durable**
- His scoring is a real outlier. He projects for about 27 points a game, far above the top 250 pool. (fact, 2026-10-16; stats)
- He commits many turnovers, about 3 a game, which clearly hurts the TO category. (fact, 2026-10-16; stats)
- Booker is an elite free throw shooter on high volume, with 7 to 8 attempts a game. This lifts a team's FT% clearly. (fact, 2026-10-14; [10-14](https://youtu.be/MRzebgip23Y?t=248), [09-10](https://youtu.be/W-R1dzem32s?t=1161), [08-09](https://youtu.be/8d--aL_xxwE?t=1295), stats)
- He is an average NBA defender: not a net negative, but not good. (verdict, 2026-08-23; [08-23](https://youtu.be/hm5-fiCa5S4?t=2021))
- FT% swings a lot from year to year. Even an 89% shooter could randomly drop to 81% in a season. (verdict, 2026-08-09; [08-09](https://youtu.be/8d--aL_xxwE?t=1295))

**Tags**
- Current: `usage competition` (Jalen Green, Miles Bridges and Dillon Brooks take touches), `position change` (Suns want to lower his ballhandling load and may play him more off the ball), `bust candidate` (Market takes him around picks 24 to 27. Experts would take him around picks 35 to 38), `sites disagree on price` (Yahoo value 31 USD and rank 24. ESPN value 17 USD and rank 39), `good playoff schedule` (Phoenix plays 4, 4 and 4 games in weeks 19 to 21), `few back-to-backs` (Phoenix has the fewest back-to-backs in the league), `questionable` (Yahoo status Q (Rest))
- Durable: `FT% anchor` (About 88% on 7 to 8 attempts a game), `PTS specialist` (About 27 points a game projected), `high TO` (About 3 turnovers a game), `punt TO fit` (Turnovers are his weakest category)

**Note.** Booker brings two real strengths, FT% (z +2.7) and points (26.7 a game), plus good assists. He also costs you about 3 turnovers a game, so he fits a punt TO build best. Our league paid 45 USD for him last season and Yahoo values him at 31 USD. The experts put him in the low 20s (22 USD in a mock) and ESPN values him at 17 USD, so do not chase him above about 25 to 30 USD. Early in the season, check whether he plays off the ball next to Jalen Green. His assists and three-point volume (2.4 threes a game at 35% is the bounce-back mark) decide whether he returns to top 30. Phoenix's 4-4-4 playoff schedule is a bonus.
